meta.name: github-gist
meta.description: Publish files or Obsidian notes as GitHub Gists. Use when user wants to share code/notes publicly, create quick shareable snippets, or publish markdown to GitHub. Triggers include "publish as gist", "create gist", "share on github", "make a gist from this".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文件或笔记一键发布为公开分享片段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把代码或笔记快速分享给他人
copy.tagline_en: Publish files or notes as shareable GitHub Gists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to share code or notes quickly

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将文件或笔记发布为 GitHub Gist，生成一个可分享的链接。默认创建私密（未列出）Gist，也可选择公开。
howto.when: 当用户要求“发布为 Gist”、“创建 Gist”、“在 GitHub 上分享”或“从这创建一个 Gist”时触发。

say.text: 把这个笔记发布为 Gist。
创建一个公开 Gist，描述为“我的代码片段”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can publish files or notes as GitHub Gists, generating a shareable link. By default, it creates a secret (unlisted) Gist, but can also create public ones.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "publish as gist", "create gist", "share on github", or "make a gist from this".

say_en.text: Publish this note as a gist.
say_en.note: Claude will publish the current note as a secret Gist and return the link.

say_en.text: Create a public gist with description "My code snippet".
say_en.note: Claude will use --public and -d flags to publish a public Gist.
